title: Data Governance & Prepositional Linkers
goal: Use formal prepositional phrases (a raíz de, en virtud de, frente a, en torno a, con respecto a, mediante) in privacy discourse.

items: I can express cause, legal basis, topic and contrast with *a raíz de*, *en virtud de*, *frente a*, *en torno a* and *con respecto a*.
I can avoid preposition slips such as *mediante de*, *en virtud a* or *a raíz con*.
I can use core terms for biometric data, mass surveillance, data protection, facial recognition, encryption and data breaches.
